text: Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, Coming November 19 - Rockstar Games An Extended Look: Now Playing An Extended Look: Now Playing Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, Coming November 19 Featuring 34 New Tracks — Listen to the First Six Singles, Available Today September 17, 2026 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , the upcoming official soundtrack album created in partnership with Atlantic Records and launching November 19 alongside Grand Theft Auto VI , is available to pre-save on all major music streaming services, with limited-edition vinyl and CD sets also available to pre-order. With 34 original tracks that capture the electric energy of Grand Theft Auto VI’s world of Vice City and Leonida, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album features a genre-defying roster of the most exciting artists in the world. Listen to the first six singles today, available across all major music streaming services: Yung Lean – That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott – RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso , PinkPantheress , Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy – Sexy Magic Morgan Wallen – Last Thing You Need Rauw Alejandro – Macacoa 2000 Keith Richards – Bright Lights, Big City Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album will also be arriving on vinyl and CD at launch, including three exclusives only available at gtavi-thealbum.com : a limited-edition liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter-edition vinyl, and a CD jewel case. Additionally, get exclusive vinyl disc colorways, each featuring unique new art, at Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target, Urban Outfitters, and indie retailers. Stay tuned for more details about the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the dynamic score, the next evolution of in-game radio, and more. They also may be used by those partners to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant ads on our Sites or other third-party sites based on topics you may like. These Cookies may also transmit personal information and video viewing information to our advertising partners and other third parties.
